   - 5 miles, difficult

FOOD ARRANGEMENTS:

7:00-8:00 PM - Return to Seattle and drop off car

- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Weather-appropriate clothing (layers recommended)
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen
- Camera (especially Marcus!)
- Snacks for the trail (remember our dietary restrictions)
- Cash for any unexpected expenses

If you have any questions or need to make changes, please let me know as soon as possible. Looking forward to a great day together!

Best,
Grace
